ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white/light-gray) pixels dominate approximately 70% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels concentrated in the central lower region and median notch area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions occupy the outer lateral lobes. A central low-intensity dark wedge extends from the median notch downwards. Discrete dark splotches are visible on the distal left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 65 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge; distinct peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in depth, with highest jaggedness on the outer halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a convex upward curve near the central notch, transitioning into a tapered concavity reaching the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-intensity circular nodes (barnacle colonies) are visible on the extreme left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent vertical low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Permanent barnacle encrustation on the tips and significant irregular tearing along the trailing edge serrations.
